speaker: caller
text: Hello, this is Officer Tan from the Singapore Police Force. We are investigating a money laundering case linked to your name.

speaker: receiver
text: What? I did not do anything.

speaker: caller
text: Your bank account will be frozen today unless you cooperate immediately. Do not tell anyone about this call.

speaker: receiver
text: Oh no, what should I do?

speaker: caller
text: To clear your name, transfer your savings to the safe account I give you and read me the OTP you receive.
